notes.title: v 0.9.0.9 Progress Update
notes.notes: v 0.9.0.9 will be delayed slightly, but will now include initial support for non VR first person play. ETA is now during august.

notes.title: v 0.9.0.9 Quick Update
notes.notes: v 0.9.0.9 is a big update with new islands, fire arms, human enemies, a motor boat, and a massive visual overhaul. Its big update so its taking some time, but should hit sometime in july.
